config.name: Command-and-control servers on the blocklist
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT count() AS "servers"
FROM (SELECT * FROM dfe.`feodo-c2` WHERE ip_address IS NOT NULL ORDER BY _timestamp_load DESC LIMIT 1 BY ip_address, port)

config.name: Servers by malware family
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT malware AS "Malware",
       count() AS "Servers",
       countIf(status = 'online') AS "Online",
       max(last_online) AS "Last online"
FROM (SELECT * FROM dfe.`feodo-c2` WHERE ip_address IS NOT NULL ORDER BY _timestamp_load DESC LIMIT 1 BY ip_address, port)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

config.name: Servers and where they are hosted
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(ip_address)), '::ffff:', '') AS "Address",
       port AS "Port",
       malware AS "Malware",
       status AS "Status",
       country AS "Country",
       as_name AS "Network",
       first_seen AS "First seen",
       last_online AS "Last online"
FROM (SELECT * FROM dfe.`feodo-c2` WHERE ip_address IS NOT NULL ORDER BY _timestamp_load DESC LIMIT 1 BY ip_address, port)
ORDER BY last_online DESC

config.name: Blocklist rows landed per poll
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp_load) AS ts,
       count() AS "rows landed"
FROM dfe.`feodo-c2`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts
